title: ElevenLabs helps people with speech loss communicate
description: ElevenLabs uses AI to create personalized voices for people who are losing their ability to speak. People with ALS and other conditions can use these voices to talk with family and participate in everyday life. In September 2026, ElevenLabs reported that its voice restoration initiative had reached more than 11,000 people worldwide. The program provides free access through partnerships with nonprofits and assistive communication organizations.
